Selected faculty are eligible for 15 days of leave per calendar year, on a cumulative basis. If a selected candidate does not join, the next eligible merit candidate will be selected. Selected candidates must submit a bond on Rs. 100 stamp paper, duly notarized, to the Director, GMC Mahabubnagar. Breaking the bond requires paying 3 months' salary. content_sections.heading: GMC Mahabubnagar Vacancy 2026 – Department-Wise Post Details
content_sections.text: GMC Mahabubnagar has announced 149 vacancies across 22 departments for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor, plus separately notified Tutor and Junior Resident posts. The notification states the vacancy position may be decreased or increased in accordance with orders of the Telangana Government.

content_sections.heading: GMC Mahabubnagar Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility follows the Teachers Eligibility Qualifications In Medical Institutions Regulations, 2025, of the National Medical Commission (NMC). Outside-state candidates must get their qualification registered with the Telangana State Medical Council within one week of selection, for their appointment to be confirmed.

rows.teaching_research_experience: Associate Professor in the subject for 3 years at a recognized medical institution (or equivalent Armed Forces specialist experience); at least 2 research publications after becoming Associate Professor (among first three authors); completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research; must undergo Basic Course in Medical Education where applicable. A Senior Consultant with 3 years as PG teacher of a broad/super specialty at an NBE-recognized government institute is also eligible.
rows.registration: MBBS and additional qualification registered with Telangana Medical Council

rows.teaching_research_experience: Assistant Professor in the subject for 4 years at a recognized medical institution, or 5 years if appointed directly as Assistant Professor in a government institution (or equivalent Armed Forces specialist experience); at least 2 research publications after becoming Assistant Professor (among first three authors); completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research; must undergo Basic Course in Medical Education where applicable. A non-teaching Consultant/Specialist/Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and 10 years' experience in at least a 220-bedded government hospital is also eligible, subject to completing both basic courses within two years.
rows.registration: MBBS and additional qualification registered with Telangana Medical Council

rows.teaching_research_experience: One year as Senior Resident in the concerned subject at a recognized medical institution (relaxed for those already appointed directly as Assistant Professor before these regulations; Tutor or Demonstrator experience with the relevant PG qualification may count as equivalent); or Armed Forces specialist routes; or a non-teaching Consultant/Specialist/Medical Officer with 2 years' experience in a 220+ bed government hospital; or diploma holders appointed as Senior Resident before 08-06-2017 with 4 years' total experience; or diploma holders with 6 years' cumulative experience as Specialist/Medical Officer in a government medical institution.

content_sections.heading: GMC Mahabubnagar Age Limit
content_sections.text: Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor: below 69 years, as on the day of notification Tutor and Junior Resident (referred to as "CAS and Tutors" in the selection-criteria clause): below 45 years, as on the day of notification To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: GMC Mahabubnagar Salary / Consolidated Pay
content_sections.text: Selected faculty will be paid a fixed consolidated monthly remuneration as per G.O. Rt. No. 1276, Finance (HRM.VII) Department, dated 16 July 2026. The remuneration is all-inclusive and subject to tax deduction at source and other statutory deductions.

content_sections.heading: GMC Mahabubnagar Selection Process
content_sections.text: Marks obtained in the MD/MS/DNB PG degree for Assistant Professor posts; marks obtained in MBBS for Tutor and Junior Resident posts (if marks are not awarded in the qualifying exam, 50% marks will be considered) For Professor and Associate Professor posts, duration of teaching experience in that cadre is considered DNB candidates will be selected as per the latest TEQ Regulations 2025 of the NMC Selection is nationwide, with first preference given to local candidates; candidates from other states will be considered if local candidates are not available Candidates due to complete Senior Residency in the first week of December 2026 are eligible, if qualified candidates are otherwise unavailable

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for GMC Mahabubnagar Walk-In Interview
content_sections.text: Filled-in application form (downloaded from the college website), with two sets of self-attested photocopies Aadhar Card and PAN Card Proof of Date of Birth (SSC certificate or Birth certificate) Study/Bonafide certificates, Class 4 to Class 10 MBBS and MD/MS/DNB Degree certificates, with marks memos of MBBS and MD/MS/DNB/MSc MBBS Registration from Telangana/AP Medical Council, and additional PG qualification registration with Telangana State Medical Council only (applications without this registration will be rejected; outside-state candidates must register within one week of selection) Experience certificates Senior Residency Completion Certificate BCBR (Basic Course in Biomedical Research) Certificate and MET (Medical Education Technology) Certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Attend the GMC Mahabubnagar Walk-In Interview
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website, www.gmcmbnr-ts.org. Fill the application form completely and attach two sets of self-attested photocopies of all required documents. Report to the Office of the Director, Government Medical College, Mahabubnagar, Edira Campus, Thirulmalla Hills, on 15-09-2026, between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM. Carry all original certificates along with the filled application and photocopies for verification. Attend the interview. Results will be declared on 17-09-2026, and selected candidates must join duty by 30-09-2026. There is no online or postal application process for this recruitment - candidates must appear in person on the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. What is GMC Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in-interview recruitment by Government Medical College, Mahabubnagar, for 149 contract faculty posts - Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Tutor, and Junior Resident - under Notification No. 02/GMC-MBNR/2026 dated 03-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMC Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 149 vacancies: 8 Professor, 19 Associate Professor, 62 Assistant Professor, 10 Tutor, and 50 Junior Resident, across 22 departments.

faq.question: Q3. When is the GMC Mahabubnagar walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 15-09-2026, from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM, at the Office of the Director, GMC Mahabubnagar, Edira Campus, Thirulmalla Hills.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GMC Mahabubnagar Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need MBBS with an MD/MS in the concerned subject and one year as Senior Resident in that subject at a recognized medical institution, along with registration with the Telangana Medical Council (alternative routes for diploma holders, Armed Forces specialists, and non-teaching specialists are also specified).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GMC Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts must be below 69 years, and candidates for Tutor and Junior Resident posts must be below 45 years, as on the day of notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for GMC Mahabubnagar faculty posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is ₹1,90,000 for Professor, ₹1,50,000 for Associate Professor, ₹1,25,000 for Assistant Professor, ₹55,000 for Tutor, and ₹46,000 for Junior Resident.

faq.question: Q7. Is the GMC Mahabubnagar application process online or offline?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview. Candidates must bring the filled application form along with original certificates and two sets of photocopies to the interview venue on 15-09-2026; there is no online or postal submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GMC Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on marks in the qualifying degree, teaching experience (for Professor and Associate Professor), and interview, as per the NMC's TEQ Regulations 2025.
